vector_memory.semantic_summary: HuggingFaceModel serves as the core service for integrating and managing LLMs from the Hugging Face Hub. It abstracts model lifecycle management, supporting quantized loading (AWQ, BNB) and inference via synchronous or streaming methods. Its primary responsibility is to execute LLM generation, handling complex configurations like TurboQuant integration and structured tool-calling detection during streaming.
